description.en: Jeju Province , officially Jeju Special Self-Governing Province , is the southernmost province of South Korea, consisting of eight inhabited and 55 uninhabited islands, including Marado, Udo, the Chuja Archipelago, and the country's largest island, Jeju Island. The province is located in the Korea Strait, with the Korean Peninsula to the northwest, Japan to the east, and China to the west.
description.zh-CN: 濟州特別自治道，简称济州道，是大韩民国西南部的島嶼地方行政区，有「東方夏威夷」之稱。由济州岛及其附属岛屿组成，总面积1847.2平方公里，人口超過60万。
description.zh-TW: 濟州特別自治道，簡稱濟州道，是大韓民國西南部的島嶼地方行政區，有「東方夏威夷」之稱。由濟州島及其附屬島嶼組成，總面積1847.2平方公里，人口超過60萬。
